Figure 3(b) presents the same data, but this time shows it as a diﬀerence network contrasting faster and slower groups, as operationalized by a median split. Blue edges indicate ordered transitions that were stronger in faster groups (negative values), whereas red edges indicate transitions that were stronger in slower groups (positive values).
